title: Claire and Marc Bourgie Pavilion

terrainReference.basis: Facade-side ground sampled from the original campus Terrarium tiles in the pavilion’s signed frame.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap mapped Montreal museum building and institutional address
mapIdentity.scope: Native pavilion way 104104907 and the official campus membership, preserved in the local Sherbrooke frame.

note: The verified original records the rounded Romanesque portals, rough pale-gray stone with warm surrounds, large fan-like semicircular window and tiers of arcade openings. From Sherbrooke the tall square bell tower is on the left, the smaller pyramidal slate roof on the right. The same native polygon encloses the rear marble-clad contemporary gallery described by its architects.
